prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless game albedo texture for small rounded weathered beach stones in an early-2000s fantasy RPG. Create one square 1024x1024 continuous surface texture, filling the whole canvas: natural muted grey-beige sandstone / fine-grained river stone, soft mineral mottling and sparse tiny dark pores, subtle fine pale mineral inclusions. A single uninterrupted stone material, not a collection of pebbles. Flat diffuse unlit base colour under uniform illumination, useful for wrapping onto rounded 3D pebble meshes; moderate texture contrast, midtone grey with restrained warm sand and cool grey variation. No directional shading, no cast shadows, no shiny highlights, no black cracks, no obvious seams, no borders, no text, no labels, no objects, no background. Believable hand-authored game surface detail at small screen size, not photoreal sharp noise. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges.
